### 1 Corinthians 16:13
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/ray-ortlund/act-like-men/
Passage: 1 Corinthians 16:13
Points:
- Modern secular culture frequently denies, mocks, or distorts godly manliness.
- The gospel affirms God's created order and gives courageous conviction a vital place.
- Paul distills the practical teachings of 1 Corinthians into a call for spiritual vigilance and strength.
- The exhortation to stand firm and act courageously applies to the entire Christian congregation.

### Firmness, Courage, and Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/firmness-courage-and-love
Passage: 1 Corinthians 16:13-14
Points:
- Standing firm in the faith requires holding unswervingly to the objective truth of Scripture.
- Believers are called to resist cultural pressures and remain brave in the Spirit's power.
- Conviction and steadfastness must never be confused with harshness toward others.
- All Christian actions and defenses of the faith must be thoroughly motivated by love and humility.
